usage: tr label add [-h] [--note NOTE] [--relabel]
                    [--tag {fact,inference,opinion}]
                    [--supported | --unsupported] [--labeller NAME]
                    ID [{met,not_met,unknown}]

positional arguments:
  ID                    a thesis id (a claim id with --claims)
  {met,not_met,unknown}
                        P1 verdict (not with --claims)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --note NOTE           why, in a sentence (stored as the label's critique)
  --relabel             replace the thesis's latest label; the new one points
                        at it
  --tag {fact,inference,opinion}
                        --claims: the claim's kind
  --supported           --claims: its sources support it
  --unsupported         --claims: its sources do not support it
  --labeller NAME       --claims: who labelled it
